title: Effect of Low-pressure Pneumoperitoneum on Pain and Inflammation Post Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the effect of low-pressure pneumoperitoneum on post operative pain and inflammation in patients undergoing elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy by comparing it to standard practice.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Elective admission for laparoscopic cholecystectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current or previous diagnosis of acute cholecystitis confirmed by ultrasound
* previous GI surgeries, except bariatric and anti-reflux surgeries
* Currently on immunosuppressant agents
* Pregnancy
* Breastfeeding
* Currently diagnosed with drug addiction
* American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) score 3 and more
